name: A needlestick
prompt: Drawing blood from a confused patient, he jerks his arm as the needle comes out. It goes into the heel of your hand through the glove.

choices.text: Report it now and go down to occupational health

outcome.told: They draw your blood and the patient's, and start the first doses while the tests run. The results come back in weeks.

choices.text: Finish the shift and report it at the end

outcome.told: You report it at the end of the shift. Occupational health starts the tests in time.

failure.told: By the time you report it the window for the first dose has narrowed. The charge nurse writes up the delay.
